title: Rust parity: Rust missing check_congestion param and CongestionError
description: Python send_datagram has check_congestion:bool that calls check_congestion_allows() and may raise CongestionError. Rust has no equivalent blocking based on congestion/priority. Fix: add check_congestion and priority-aware blocking.
close_reason: Fixed: Added CongestionError, check_congestion_allows(level, priority) function, and congestion_level/congestion_state methods to DutyCycleTracker. Brings Rust to parity with Python coap/params.py congestion control API.
